subject: [PATCH 3/6] x86/virt/tdx: Detect if the extensions initialization is required

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about safety when yanking PAMT from under TDMRs, suggesting TDH.SYS.SHUTDOWN/DISABLE on error.

reviews.author: Edgecombe, Rick P
reviews.summary: Questioned the patch's approach to resetting memory and potential differences with bailing halfway during TDMR initialization.

2026-08-21.patch_summary: Patch introduces a new mechanism to detect if TDX extensions initialization is required.
